rationale: Repsol's first-half 2026 report directly establishes that Stonepeak's 43.8% acquisition closed in February 2026 after the conditions were satisfied. European Commission evidence identifies Outpost Solar SellCo LLC as the jointly controlled target that owns and operates the 629 MW Webb County project. Outpost is therefore an active standalone infrastructure asset/JV, not a broad solar-development platform.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Outpost Solar record classified as an operating utility-scale solar asset / project-holding joint venture.
Record Stonepeak's 43.8% active ownership from February 2026; leave the exact day, fund and acquisition SPV as NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
Record Repsol as the continuing joint-control owner; label 56.2% as arithmetically derived rather than separately disclosed.
Use Outpost Solar SellCo LLC as the transaction target and Hecate Energy Outpost Solar LLC as an underlying project entity, not separate PortCos.
Do not merge Outpost with Stonepeak's separate Frye/Jicarilla renewables portfolio.
Replace the pending-incoming census state with CLOSED_ACTIVE and correct the announcement date to December 11, 2025.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact February 2026 closing day, Stonepeak fund/acquisition SPV and lower legal-entity chain are not publicly disclosed.
PPA counterparty and contracted volume and the tax-equity investor and rights are not publicly disclosed.
